## Orientation

Work only in ~/se-workflow on branch feat/dashboard-ui (HEAD da2d120). This is a repair: reproduce first, record what you observe, name the root cause, then fix. The detail screen is `TaskDetailScreen` in `scripts/dashboard_app.py`; it re-renders under an asyncio lock after its own change token changes, and the test polls with bounded waits. A loop of the single test (see the acceptance command) is the reproduction harness; running it under CPU load (e.g. alongside a parallel pytest run) makes the failure more frequent. Fix the screen, not the test, unless the test itself queries a widget that can legitimately be absent mid-render.
record.subject: detail-redraw-race
